content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 4 to 6)
FERRIES (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This task is about the time it takes a ferry to leave an island and travel to the mainland.
Jin owns a ferry.

parts.text: The ferry leaves the island when there are 10 passengers on the ferry. In this question, there are already 6 passengers on the ferry. This means the ferry needs 4 more passengers before it leaves. Jin wants to model how long the ferry waits at the island before travelling to the mainland. He assumes the passengers arrive one at a time.
